summary:
Plan of w2 (work-queue#r1, #r7) written; one question is left: the empty title.
No accepted scenario is red: all 14 pass. The defects (a title with / is refused; a title with LF or CR is written) are covered by no scenario.
The plan adds tests/scripts/test_work_add_title.py so the implementer sees D1-D3 fail first.
Decisions: a title is free text (r1); LF or CR in a title is refused under r7, because the heading is one line (r1) and a CR splits it when the file is read back.
Changes: scripts/workqueue.py add (drop the old file-name check on the title, add the newline/CR check); scripts/work (rename the argument name -> title); skills/migrating-to-capabilities/SKILL.md line 111.
Tests broken: none.
Open: what an empty title does; no requirement, design-decision or ruling settles it.
questions: Is an empty title refused by `work add`? r1 writes the title as the `# ` heading and r7 refuses only what cannot be done. Reading A (refuse): `work add i1 "" ...` exits with an error saying the title is empty and changes nothing, so no w<n> is printed and no file is written (today it is refused, but with the message `the name  is not a file name`). Reading B (write): it prints w<n> and writes .shop/work/i1/w<n>.md as drafted with an empty `# ` heading.
